column1: # Provenance ledger. Every file carrying an "Extracted from" header has exactly one row here,
# and every row has exactly one such file. scripts/check-provenance.mjs asserts both directions.
# action:  move = byte-identical apart from the header
#          port = adapted during the move (decoupled from massing APIs, retyped, or split)
# The weekly divergence report reads massing_path + massing_sha to find upstream commits that
# touched code we extracted. Keeping massing_sha accurate is what makes that report trustworthy.
